Description: The digital worker performs a weekly extraction of missing OTC and check-up products, followed by data processing in the Access database.
On a daily basis, the bot extracts information related to warehouse stock load and uploads it into SAP.
The bot processes PDF files related to off-canvass orders and sends them to the appropriate directors based on geographic area and company affiliation.
The digital worker enters or updates pharma, OTC, API, and optical label orders in SAP for Berlin-Chemie.

The bot access to EudraVigilance website and download ICSRs (.xml) related to Menarini’s products. After that the DW analyses ICSRs according to predefined parsing rules with the final purpose of deciding if an ICSR is related to Menarini products and/or to active ingredients used in Menarini’s products;
Then the bot downloads EV form and .rtf files associated to all ICSRs related to Menarini’s products and send emails to DSUs for final case validation.

Everyday the Digital Worker perform continuous health checks of the 11 most used Menarini’s applications. In case of any issues being revealed an email needs to be sent immediately to the specific persons that will proceed with further investigation of the issue or will take the corrective actions.

When in the Menarini’s global DB of doctors and pharmacists is added a new record having FC equal to one or more existing records, the automation has to keep only one active doctor or pharmacist (main doctor), aggregating all info and dismissing duplicate records.
For each new supply chain flow, the robot assigns appropriate permissions to interested active users, deletes the permissions that already exist and uploads the updated authorization file in SAP.

An affiliate can request to change an order. These changes create an amendment (a workflow) in SAP APO (Advanced Planner and Optimizer) between the affiliate, manufacturer and/or logistic. The stakeholders must answer to the amendment, in order to close it. The amendments must be closed within a short period, since they create discontinuity of the production. The user checks on APO if there are amendments with status "Open" or "To be confirmed". Depending on the status, a reminder must be sent to the interested contact person.

The end-to-end process takes 2 hours every time it is done. The process should be done every day, in order to reduce the impact on the production.

Once a month the DW extracts from SAP the list of all return deliveries that have been opened  for more than 30 days. The information extracted is stored in an Excel file. Afterwards, the file is formatted with a new column and sent to the final users.

The process starts with the extraction from SAP of the list of all diagnostics deliveries using dedicated SAP variants. The information extracted from SAP is stored in an Excel file. There are two Excel templates: the first one for ZRE/ZRHO (only warehouses), and the second one for all other cases. Finally, the Excel file is sent to dedicated users.

On a daily basis DW extracts from SAP a list of all orders having a ‘Double Order within Month’ or ‘Duplicated Order’ block. Then the bot retrieves from SAP information relative to the order, previously processed, having the same client, product number and the delivery date within the same month to the blocked order. Based on the user that created the blocked order, the DW sends two different types of emails: directors and/or contact person.

On a daily basis a robot extracts from SAP the list of MIS and OCR-ICR orders having a block ‘Fuori Canvass’. The extracted orders are sent to directors in charge and once verified, they send a communication to the back office users asking for unlocking or revoking the specific order.

RPA ID (CMBD): RPA - Uploading of documents in Archiflow
Description: For all international sales, DW stored riceived documents as attachments to a specific invoice in Archiflow. Once the Movement Reference Number (MRN) notification is received, the bot  uploads it in Archiflow and associates it with all the related invoices.

On a daily basis DW extracts from SAP the list of orders having specific  ‘Sold to party’ values and for each order verifies that the payment condition is the same as the one saved in SAP master data. If some inconsistencies occur, the bot revokes the order and sends a notification to the person that created the order.

The Digital Worker must send an approval email to the invoice approvers and proceed to release the invoice payment in the P2P system after receiving an email response from the approvers.
The invoices arriving in P2P for approval are exclusively Italian electronic invoices, either unordered or with discrepancies.

The robot downloads data from SAP APO to create and send MOC alert reports to dedicated actors in order to monitor all significant deviations according to a safety stock threshold specified by business.

Two times a day, DW downloads from the Supervisor website the list of all orders, identify all orders that have been created after the last processing. For these orders the bot downloads the associated pdf files, then send them and the Excel file to dedicated users.​

On a daily basis the bot extracts from SAP the list of all return deliveries that have been created two days before the current date. Return deliveries in scope are "vendita" and "campionatura". The information extracted is stored in an Excel file, formatted and sent to the final users.

RPA ID (CMBD): RPA - Uploading Purchase Orders in SAP
Description: For each order, the automation extracts from the .pdf file all necessary information needed to successfully complete the entire process. Before proceeding with the creation or modification of an order, it is necessary to verify that it is not already present in SAP. The modification of an order can only affect the quantity or the delivery date of a product.

On a daily basis the DW downloads from the MD portal list of all tickets that have been opened during the previous working day. All retrieved tickets have to be imported in SAP, performing, when possible, the movement of the materials between the warehouses.
Every 6 months the DW sends an email with templates of both anti-mafia declaration and self-certification of pending charges to a list of executives.

On a daily basis a list of all orders having a ‘Minimum and Max Order Net Value’ block is extracted from SAP, retrieving information related to the order and extract the pdf of the order. At the end of the process, th automation sends an email to Directors. Process will be done for Codifi (internal) ‘Net Value’ orders for which the communication is sent to Codifi director.

Every two days the DW extracts from SAP the list of all diagnostics return deliveries. The information extracted is stored in an Excel file. Afterwards, the file is formatted with a new columns and sent to the final users.​

Every day, the automation retrieves all emails containing a request for the promotional materials. After having extracted all information for creating DDTs and Tags from the email body, the bot perform data entry in AS400 without doing any transcoding. In the end they save the  DDT/Tag and automatically the printing job starts.

RPA ID (CMBD): RPA - Comm of Orders Blocked due to Insolvency
Description: Every day, the DW extracts from SAP list of orders and relative clients having a “Customer Credit status check” block. Then the bot accesses the AS400 and retrieves for each client the information regarding the expired and not paid invoices. Finally, it sends an email communication to the identified clients indicating the blocked order(s) and not compliant invoices.
The robot retrieves and processes all daily EMVO L5 alerts to address alert's root cause and communicates them to dedicated users. Then, a final report are created and saved in the dedicated Drive.

RPA ID (CMBD): RPA - Sconto Merce and Supero Valore Orders
Description: Every day, the automation extracts form SAP the list of orders having a block “Sconto Merce” or “Supero Valore”, downloading related pdf files. For each order that has not been processed previously, the bot sends and email to the related business users.

RPA ID (CMBD): RPA - Sconto Merce and Supero Valore Orders
Description: Every day, DW converts approval emails into pdf files, then extracts SAP order number from the email subject and upload the relative .pdf file in SAP (transaction VA03).

RPA ID (CMBD): RPA - Storage invoices documents in Archiflow
Description: On a daily basis, the automation downloads from Salesforce documentation regarding credit notes. At first, analyzing credit notes and then identify the invoice they are related to. Afterwards, the bot uploads in Archiflow all downloaded documents related to the corresponding invoice.

RPA ID (CMBD): RPA - Revoking of acc. blocked orders
Description: On a daily basis, DW launches the transaction ZSD046 to revoke all retrieved orders.

Three times a day, business users download from Supervisor all .pdf files related to new orders. For each .pdf file, the bot verifies if products Vaborem and/or Tenkasi are present and checks if there are new Stemline orders on Supervisor. In the end, an email containing identified orders has to be sent to the Order Management office.

On a daily basis, the bot tracks EU shippings checking DHL and TNT websites. If the shipping ends, the automation downloads the associated .pdf file and upload it in Archiflow in the dedicated invoice folder. Furthermore, the DW logs in in SAP (transaction ZSD098) and flag the field CMR/POD corresponding to the processed shipping.

Once a month, the automation compares the invoiced quantity with the offered package quantity. If the first one is greater than the second one, the bot will send an alert email to the related customer.

On a daily basis, the automation analyzes orders that are blocked due to lack of products by running he transaction ZSD046, in particular, it is focused on both wholesalers’ and pharmacies’ orders. After applying series of filters, the bot reject the remaining orders. In the end, a confirmation email is sent to business users attaching initial reports extracted from SAP.

On a daily basis, the automation extracts from SAP the list of several types of products that have to be put out of order (transaction MB5M with 5 different variants). Afterwards, all identified materials are put out of order using the transaction MB1B.

When a user creates a PR by retrieving the budget from Einstein, they should download all the PDFs containing the purchase request details received via email from Einstein and upload them to the P2P system. The Digital Worker automatically completes this process, retrieving the PDFs from the user's email and attaching them to the PR, without the user having to do so.

Every day, the DW must download the list of invoices received from Archiflow and the list of purchase orders received from P2P, matching the purchase orders with their corresponding master invoices. If the purchase order requires the issuance of a BAP, the Digital Worker must send an email request to the user processing the purchase order, citing the invoice and purchase order details and codes.
The robot updates the orders in AS400 and SAP according to the changes performed by users in P2P.
The robot activates a payment proposal both for suppliers and intercompany. Once the procedure has been started and the conditions of the proposal are confirmed, the payment can be run.

According to the codes’ list to be phased out or modified, the robot retrieves all necessary information to correctly perform the requested action in AS400 and, at the end, sends an email to the requestor.

RPA ID (CMBD): RPA - Analysis of Packaging Line Reports
Description: According to custom rules, the robot creates a structured report with machine protocols data to get better understanding of the production machines and reduce errors and defective goods.

RPA ID (CMBD): RPA - Sending Master Data to warehouses
Description: On a daily basis, an Excel file with new and/or updated records is sent to the warehouse’s supervisors.

RPA ID (CMBD): RPA - Uploading invoices of Fine Foods
Description: Every day, the automation downloads all pdf files from emails sent by Fine Foods and extract, from each file, all necessary information (e.g. invoice number, invoice date, …). All extracted data are inserted in SAP (transaction MIGO).

Multiple times a day, the stock levels of all Menarini Group's warehouses are matched with the central warehouse in Capalle using the SAP transaction ZINV001. Based on the required days of coverage it’s necessary to choose between standard or urgent STO. Results are reported to the central warehouse’s business users.
Daily, automation accesses Oracle Database, extract various data from different view and then stored them in a dedicated Excel file.

Daily, automations extract products data from specific emails and insert in Veeva portal in order to retrieve the associated report. Then, the information present in the Veeva report are copied in the corresponding Google Sheet.
Custom web application that allows business users to insert all necessary information related to claims through a standard form and then they can track and store data.

Twice a day, the PDFs related to NSO orders are moved from Daphne Menarini Diagnostic server (FileZilla) to Daphne Menarini Diagnostic internal (FileZilla). Within SAP (using transaction WE02), IDOCs located in the ZNSO_orders_diagnostic folder are checked. Launching SQVI transaction, a comparison is made to ensure the documents count between SAP and FileZilla matches. An email is sent to users to inform them of the orders' successful uploading.

RPA ID (CMBD): RPA - Uploading invoices of LMSA Spain
Description: Every day, the automation downloads all files from emails sent by LMSA and extracts all necessary information related to invoices, then checks if the processing invoice is already present in SAP with the transaction ME2N. If compared quantities are equal, all extracted data are inserted in SAP (transaction MIGO) and then the bot checka if inserted data has been correctly uploaded (transaction MMBE).

RPA ID (CMBD): RPA - Inserting pharma orders in Salesforce
Description: Multiple times a day, orders from pharmacies are entered into Salesforce based on the customer code and the order type (Direct, Transfer Order, Ethical). All needed information are retrieved from PDF orders. Once filled out, orders are left in a pending state to allow reviews and potential changes

The DW extracts from SAP the list of all pending orders, pending products, pending rents, obsolete products and row blocked for price different and CIG. Each extracted information will be stored in a certain Excel file, formatted and sent to relative business users.

RPA ID (CMBD): RPA - Reporting products marketing discontinuation PRD
Description: The automation must send a notification email to customers when a product is no longer available on the market. For this reason, they periodically review data retrieved from BI and if necessary, they update the corresponding customers by email, sending them a defined PDF file.

The Digital Worker downloads SAP ECC, SAP S4 and AS400 VAT registers data of all Menarini Italian companies and perform series of controls on retrieved data, then send draft reports to business users.
The digital worker performs the enrichment of electronic invoices by reading PO field and completing missing data. Through a user interface BUs can validate data or change it.
Starting from a file of IDM downloaded weekly (?), the DW checks whether there are new users to be profiled in P2P or users to be disabled and proceed with the creation or deactivation.

Rabot will open the Database submission sheet considering only the tab Template New RO to collect the input data for the creation of the Regulatory Objective in Veeva and sending an error to the editor if it is empty. at the end of the process, Rabot will send a response to the editor who triggered the process and the DB Team, confirming whether it completed successfully or encountered any errors.

Rabot will open the Database submission sheet considering only the tab Template New RO to collect the input data for the creation of the Regulatory Objective in Veeva and sending an error to the editor if it is empty. at the end of the process, Rabot will send a response to the editor who triggered the process and the DB Team, confirming whether it completed successfully or encountered any errors.

Each month Menarini has to submit business turnover data to the European Diagnostic Manufacturers Association (EDMA) by uploading a report to the MIS Portal. The report includes the sales performance of specific products identified by a unique MIS code, incoming from all Menarini affiliates. Each affiliate sends the data using a standard template. All the data provided by the affiliates will be consolidated into a single Excel file report. Then a .csv file containing all the required sales information will be generated from the Excel report and it must be uploaded to the MIS Portal.
The DW compares data extracted from BI with data from PDF orders, verifying their match to confirm payment of transfer orders to wholesalers.

Menarini Group's warehouses match their stock levels with the central warehouse in UPS multiple times a day using the SAP transaction ZINV001. The standard or urgent STO is chosen based on the required days of coverage. The delivery is then generated and sent to central warehouse’s business users via the SAP transaction VL10F.

On a daily basis, the automation checks for blocked orders due to missing products, obsolete products or insolvency. If necessary, a cancellation letter is sent to the corresponding customer by email. Each email is then archived in SAP according to the related Sales Document

RPA ID (CMBD): RPA - Uploading invoices of MVH DRESDA
Description: On a daily basis, the DW extracts batch information (e.g. number, expiration date, quantity, …) from MVH DRESDA invoices. Extracted data is then entered into SAP for both inbound and outbound deliveries to activate invoicing from AMFI to the Menarini Benelux affiliate.
